source: E. coli promoter expression NOISE (Urchueguia et al. PLOS Biol 2021 DOI 10.1371/journal.pbio.3001491; Zenodo 5701705 processed_datasets_v2.zip dataset_with_noise_estimates.csv, condition='M9 + 0.2% glucose'); 每 natural promoter/intergenic sequence(96-1738nt)+ noise(mean-independent noise = log-variance 减同均值 floor)+ fl_mean_log(mean 表达 控制)+ gene_downstream; readout = 分布二阶矩 expression noise, 非 level/rate/丰度
cannot_claim: noise~mean 强相关(intrinsic Poisson floor)→ baseline 必含 fl_mean_log; 测 higher-order 结构 beyond composition+mean
natural E. coli promoter → regulon/gene-neighborhood leakage(同 TF 调控的不同序列 noise 相关)→ k-mer identity-cluster holdout + leave-gene-out(gene_downstream)迁移
单 condition(M9+glucose)避免同序列跨 8 condition 泄漏; noise 已部分 mean-independent 但仍加 mean 控制
变长序列(96-1738nt)→ 所有特征 length-normalized
NEW readout 类型 = expression noise(二阶矩), registry 未覆盖(现有 promoter claim 是 de Boer2020 random-promoter LEVEL); fresh contact 非新机制
